benchmark.note: Per-deal: the gauntlet replayed the benchmark seed list exactly (both orientations, same start seats). The pairing is cross-run — per-game records are not joined — so the delta SE is the conservative independent combination, an upper bound on the true paired SE.

predictions.text: The counter table's punter row weakly dominates every column, so a warm adaptive team should match punter's matrix-v2 row against every pure style within CI. Any detectable shortfall is the price of the warmup anchor (Balanced until ~60 observed events).

The adaptive-vs-punter mixed-population delta should be ≈ 0: both teams best-respond to every composition with the same style once warm, so adaptation buys nothing a fixed punter team does not already have.
Oracle classification should add ≈ nothing: the best response is punter regardless of the read, so a perfect read and a classifier read select the same play.

Classifier top-1 accuracy should be good for turtle, ghost and hoarder, and heavily confused inside the balanced/blitz/punter/banker quadrangle (the Stage-1B separability read: those four diverge from Balanced on under 1.3% of decisions).

verdicts.prediction: The counter table's punter row weakly dominates every column, so a warm adaptive team should match punter's matrix-v2 row against every pure style within CI. Any detectable shortfall is the price of the warmup anchor (Balanced until ~60 observed events).
verdicts.detail: worst cell vs punter: delta -0.0066 ± 0.0027 (z -2.47); 0 of 9 cells reject at the Bonferroni bound |z| > 2.773; 2 between 1.96 and the bound (balanced, punter). The delta SE is the conservative cross-run combination over shared deals, so the test is weaker than a jointly-recorded pairing would be; smallest rejectable shortfall ~0.0196 at the widest cell.

verdicts.prediction: The adaptive-vs-punter mixed-population delta should be ≈ 0: both teams best-respond to every composition with the same style once warm, so adaptation buys nothing a fixed punter team does not already have.
verdicts.detail: pooled per-deal delta -0.0074 ± 0.0042 over 24 compositions × 400 pairs (z -1.77; 95% CI [-0.0157, 0.0008]), truly paired within the run. The SE is clustered by seed: all 24 compositions replay one 400-seed list, so per-deal deltas are averaged within seed before the SE is taken over the seed-level means — replays of a deal are not counted as independent.

verdicts.prediction: Oracle classification should add ≈ nothing: the best response is punter regardless of the read, so a perfect read and a classifier read select the same play.
verdicts.detail: every oracle cell measured a delta of exactly 0.0000: with a dominant counter-table row, the oracle and classifier arms delegate to the same style at every decision, so the paired games are identical move for move. Perfect classification bought nothing, measurably and exactly.

verdicts.prediction: Classifier top-1 accuracy should be good for turtle, ghost and hoarder, and heavily confused inside the balanced/blitz/punter/banker quadrangle (the Stage-1B separability read: those four diverge from Balanced on under 1.3% of decisions).
verdicts.detail: end-of-game top-1 — turtle 0.3208, ghost 0.4142, hoarder 0.2925 (mean 0.3425, condition >= 0.50: fails); quadrangle balanced 0.2325, blitz 0.1383, punter 0.0358, banker 0.1125 (mean 0.1298, condition <= 0.35: holds); quadrangle errors landing inside the quadrangle: 0.3561, 0.4304, 0.4693, 0.3981 (condition every >= 0.50: fails).
